learnings.title: Treasury yield falls during tech selloff must not be scored as altcoin risk-on
learnings.claim: On 22 October 2026 the US Treasury official par-yield series shows the 2-year yield fell from 4.81% to 4.65% and 10-year from 5.13% to 4.96%, while the Nasdaq Composite fell 2.60%; falling sovereign yields during equity selloffs can reflect flight-to-safety rather than a broad risk-on liquidity improvement.
learnings.decision: FINANCE_TREASURY_RISKOFF_GATE: When bond yields fall, check contemporaneous equity breadth, volatility, credit spreads and cause. If equities sell off and Treasuries rally on flight-to-safety, classify as risk-off/ambiguous, never automatically bullish for altcoins; do not invent a calibrated score.
learnings.next_measurement: Check 23 October closing equity breadth, VIX and credit spreads against the 22 October Treasury yield move, then test rule in next daily Altcoin panel.
failure_history: Prior daily Altcoin reports sometimes treated lower US yields alone as supportive without separating safe-haven demand from liquidity easing.
fallback_history: If equity breadth or volatility cannot be verified for the same session, classify combined risk-on as N/A rather than bullish.
